inputs.text: This is yet another clear sign that public institutions claiming to fight inequality are repeatedly failing the marginalized communities they say they serve. South African actress Terry Pheto is being linked to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission for R20.56 million in this SIU probe, with fresh details presented during the briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. These scandals lay bare deep structural failures rooted in historical inequality, where money meant for community upliftment and reducing disparities gets diverted, hitting the most vulnerable groups hardest. We need real institutional reform to break these patterns of mismanagement and redirect public funds toward genuine social justice instead of locking in the same disparities.
